d: Rucking, or loaded movement, is one of the most efficient and safest ways to burn fat and build muscle at the same time. People have been rucking ever since the dawn of time, not with a rucksack, but with everything else they’ve had to carry for survival. It’s in our nature to do this! Let me know if you have any questions about rucking in the comments, I’ll do my best to get back to you!
